HEADER: NE Gargantuan Outsider (Boss, Daemon, Earth, Extraplanar) [size may vary depending on room]
DEFENSE: AC 26, touch 9, flat-footed 23 (+3 dex, +17 natural, -4 size)
Immune Disease, Death Effects, Earth, Petrification/Statue, Poison
TACTICS: During Combat Demon Wall begins by casting debuffs upon its foes while always moving closer towards the other end of the room. If anyone is within range, Demon Wall can choose to physically attack them.
OFFENSE: Speed 10 ft. (depends on the size of the room)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 20 ft. [depends on its size]
STATISTICS: Str 32, Dex 16, Con 30, Int 10, Wis 26, Cha 14
Feats Cleave, Combat Casting, Extend Spell, Improved Critical (Claw), Improved Natural Attack (Claw), Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Toughness, Vital Attack
Skill Bluff +23, Intimidate +23, Knowledge (Planes) +21, Perception +29, Sense Motive +29, Spellcraft +21
SQ Movable Object, Second Wind, Status+
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Crush (ex) After 5 to 10 turns (DM's choice), Demon Wall will reach the other side of the room and will crush all of its opponents inflicting instant death unless they managed to get out of the room. (Cannot be used by any class)

Dark Reach (su) Once below 50% health (360), this Burst Mode lets Demon Wall have a better control over the room it is in for a number of rounds equal to 1 + 1 round for every four HD. It gains a +4 spell save DC to all its enfeebling spells and it has double reach with its attacks. It is also granted one extra standard action per round, which can be used to break the usual limit of only casting two spells per round. This limit break requires only a swift action to activate.

Movable Object (ex) Demon Wall can move at its normal speed while attacking or casting spells without needing to make any checks and does not take any attacks of opportunity while doing so. If anything is in the path of the Demon Wall's movement, that creature or object is automatically pushed back with no save. (Cannot be used by any class)
Second Wind (ex) Once below 50% HP (360), Demon Wall will increase its claw damage by one dice size and critical range by 2 for the rest of the fight.
Status+ (ex) Demon Wall adds half of his HD (+9) to its spell duration.

parsed.description: A stone wall possessed by a demon. A trap constructed in ancient times, it chases down opposing forces until it can flatten them. Adventurers are said to go crazy unable to exert their true power due to the fear caused by the wall slowly closing in on them with no escape. It may be impossible to defeat this enemy if one possesses strength but not the necessary willpower as well.

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
